translation.en: The heart beats.
The doctor examined the heart.
I felt joy in the heart.
The doctor heard the beat of the heart.
The truthful person is loved.
People love the truthful person.
The student sat with the truthful.
The speech of a truthful person is clear.
The eye turned red.
The doctor examined the eye.
The dust got into the eye.
The colour of the eye is black.
Livelihood is scarce this year.

translation.bs: Čovjek je našao opskrbu u gradu.
translation.en: The man found a livelihood in the city.
The farmer was glad of the livelihood.
The source of livelihood is work.
The consequence of laziness is bad.
The student feared the consequence.
The man thought about the consequence.
Fear of the consequence prevents mistakes.
A good deed is never lost.
The child did a good deed.

translation.bs: Komšija se zahvalio mladiću na dobročinstvu.
translation.en: The neighbor thanked the young man for the good deed.
The effect of a good deed is beautiful.
The report arrived yesterday.
The father heard the report.
The neighbors spoke about the report.
The correctness of the report is important.
A century is a hundred years.
The students studied the past century.

translation.bs: Pjesnik je živio u prošlom stoljeću.
translation.en: The poet lived in the last century.
The events of the century are many.
The birds twittered.
The child fed the birds.
The hunter looked at the birds.
The birds' feathers are colourful.
The ear hears the sound.
The doctor examined the ear.

translation.bs: Ljekar je stavio lijek u uho.
translation.en: The doctor put the medicine in the ear.
The ear pain is severe.

translation.bs: Sumnja je ušla u njegovo srce.
translation.en: Doubt entered his heart.
The speech raised doubt.

translation.bs: Sudija je pogledao čovjeka sa sumnjom.
translation.en: The judge looked at the man with doubt.
The disappearance of doubt gladdens the student.
The shout awakened the child.
The neighbors heard the shout.
The child was afraid of the shout.
The strength of the shout is great.
The secret is preserved.
The friend concealed the secret.
The girl spoke about the secret.
Knowing the secret is difficult.
The fruit is delicious.
The father purchased the fruit.
The family eats some of the fruit.
The dish of fruit is on the table.

translation.bs: Dobra djela koja je susjed učinio su brojna.
translation.en: The good deeds the neighbor did are many.
The neighbor did good deeds.

translation.bs: Siromasi su zahvalili susjedu na dobrim djelima.
translation.en: The poor thanked the neighbor for the good deeds.
Doing good deeds is beautiful.
Impurity spoils the heart.
The young man avoided impurity.

translation.bs: Čovjek je očistio svoje srce od nečistoće.
translation.en: The man purified his heart from impurity.
The effect of impurity is bad.
Falsehood harms people.
The man believed the falsehood.
The father warned of falsehood.
The danger of falsehood is great.
The right side is clean.
The worker painted the side.

translation.bs: Čovjek je stajao na drugoj strani.
translation.en: The man stood on the other side.
The length of the side is short.
The plants grew quickly.
The farmer watered the plants.
The cow ate from the plants.
The color of the plants is green.
The storehouses are full.
The guard opened the storehouses.

translation.bs: Kralj je stavio zlato u riznice.
translation.en: The king put the gold in the treasuries.
The key of the storehouses is lost.
The burden is heavy on the donkey.
The father decreased the burden.
The donkey got tired of the burden.
The weight of the burden is large.
The number of students increased.
The child wrote the number.

translation.bs: Djevojčica je počela s prvim brojem.
translation.en: The girl started with the first number.
The value of the number is large.
Greed spoils friendship.
People hate greed.
The man kept away from greed.
The danger of greed is great.
The cradle is near the bed.
The father bought a new cradle.
The child slept in the cradle.
The cover of the cradle is white.
The cups are on the table.
The girl washed the cups.

translation.bs: Otac je sipao sok u čaše.
translation.en: The father poured the juice into the cups.
The color of the cups is blue.
Iniquity is a bad habit.
People hate iniquity.
The merchant kept away from iniquity.
The consequence of iniquity is bad.
The ewe ate the grass.
The farmer milked the ewe.
The child gave water to the ewes.
The wool of the ewe is soft.
The rest of the food is in the refrigerator.
The child ate the rest of the cake.

translation.bs: Otac je govorio o ostatku priče.
translation.en: The father spoke about the rest of the story.

translation.bs: Polovina ostatka je za tvog brata.
translation.en: Half of the remainder is for your brother.
The loss was large.
The merchant was afraid of the loss.
The merchant learned from the loss.
The manager knew the cause of the loss.
The newborn cried in the night.
The grandmother carried the newborn.
The family rejoiced at the newborn.
The father selected the newborn's name.
The amount was small.
The mother determined the amount of salt.
The merchant spoke about the amount.
The increase of the amount is useful.
Lineage is important for the tribe.
The grandfather knew the family's lineage.

translation.bs: Dijete je pitalo svog djeda o porijeklu.
translation.en: The child asked his grandfather about the lineage.
The knowledge of lineage is old.
The child's weight increased.
The doctor measured the patient's weight.
The mother asked about the weight.
The increase of weight is harmful.
The new furniture arrived.
The workers moved the furniture.
The mother spoke about the furniture.
The color of the furniture is beautiful.
The camels eat the grass.
The Bedouin watered the camels.
The merchants travelled on camels.
The Bedouin drank camel milk.
Honoring the guest is a duty.
The teacher deserves honor.

translation.bs: Otac je dočekao gosta s počastima.
translation.en: The father received the guest with honor.
The custom of honor is beautiful.
A snake entered the garden.
The farmer saw a snake.
The children flee from the snake.
The snake's color is green.
The worker's forearm is strong.
The doctor examined the forearm.

translation.bs: Igrač je osjetio bol u podlaktici.
translation.en: The player felt pain in the forearm.
The forearm muscles are strong.
Fright afflicted the people.
The sound caused fright.
The child screamed from fright.
The cause of the fright is the sound of the thunder.
